highlights: The AI landscape is seeing significant advancements in multimodal generation with MiniMax H3's omni-modal video model and Google DeepMind's physical AI for robotics.
Developer productivity tools are emerging, notably JetBrains' open-source KotlinLLM for runtime code generation and Supabase Evals for benchmarking coding agents on real-world tasks.

Major platforms continue to expand their agent capabilities and model efficiency, with Google enhancing Gemini API Managed Agents and OpenAI integrating health features into ChatGPT while optimizing GPT-5.6 price-performance.

agents.title: Gemini API Managed Agents Gain 3.6 Flash, Hooks, and More
agents.summary: Google has significantly enhanced its Gemini API Managed Agents with new capabilities including 3.6 Flash integration and hooks, empowering developers to build more reliable and production-ready AI agents.

agents.title: Nous Research Integrates Hermes Agent with Buzz, Block's Open Source Nostr Workspace
agents.summary: Nous Research introduced three integration paths for its Hermes Agent with Buzz, Block's open-source Nostr workspace, enabling seamless human-AI agent collaboration and deployment in a self-hostable environment.

agents.title: Scientific Computing Accelerated by Agentic AI
agents.summary: A new field report from OpenAI highlights how AI coding agents are revolutionizing scientific computing, modernizing software development and accelerating discovery across fields like genomics.

models.title: MiniMax Releases MiniMax H3: Omni-Modal Video Model with 2K Clips and Native Stereo Audio
models.summary: MiniMax unveiled MiniMax H3, a groundbreaking general-purpose omni-modal model capable of generating 15-second 2K video clips with native stereo audio, unifying text, image, video, and audio contexts for comprehensive generation.

models.title: Google DeepMind Ships Three Physical AI Models for Robotics Control and Collaboration
models.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2, an intelligence layer for next-gen robots, featuring models for whole-body humanoid control, embodied reasoning (ER 2), and on-device adaptation for multi-robot collaboration.

models.title: PolyAI Releases Dialog-RSN-1: An Audio-Native Dialog Model
models.summary: PolyAI introduced Dialog-RSN-1, an innovative audio-native dialog model that directly processes caller audio, fusing turn-taking, speech recognition, function calling, and response generation into a single system for sub-300ms responses.

tools.title: JetBrains Open-Sources KotlinLLM: Smart Macros for Runtime Code Generation
tools.summary: JetBrains Research open-sourced KotlinLLM, an IntelliJ IDEA plugin prototype that introduces 'Smart macros' for generating and hot-reloading Kotlin source code at runtime using LLMs, significantly enhancing developer agility and scenarios completion.

tools.title: Supabase Releases Evals: An Open Source Benchmark for Coding Agents
tools.summary: Supabase has open-sourced 'supabase/evals', an Apache-2.0 benchmark and framework designed to evaluate coding agents like Claude Code and Codex against real Supabase tasks, providing deterministic scoring and LLM-as-a-judge capabilities.

tools.title: Tencent Open-Sources AngelSpec: Unified Training Framework for Speculative Decoding
tools.summary: Tencent released AngelSpec, an open-source torch-native framework that unifies training for speculative-decoding draft models, introducing DFly for block-diffusion drafting and D-cut for adaptive verification budgeting, leading to significant inference speedups.

companies.title: OpenAI Launches Health in ChatGPT, Integrating Medical Records and Apple Health
companies.summary: OpenAI has introduced 'Health in ChatGPT', allowing eligible U.S. users to securely connect medical records and Apple Health data for personalized health insights and better understanding of their well-being.

companies.title: OpenAI Advances GPT-5.6 Price-Performance Frontier
companies.summary: OpenAI announced lower pricing for GPT-5.6 models (Luna and Terra), emphasizing its commitment to efficient models that enable enterprises to deploy AI workflows at scale with improved price-performance.

companies.title: Google Vids Updates Introduce Gemini Omni and Personal Avatars for Video Creation
companies.summary: Google Vids received two significant updates, Gemini Omni and personal avatars, designed to simplify video creation and editing, making the process more intuitive and accessible for users.

learning.title: OpenAI Provides Free ChatGPT Access to 100,000 Academic Researchers
learning.summary: OpenAI is offering 100,000 academic researchers free access to its most advanced AI models via ChatGPT, aiming to significantly accelerate scientific research, collaboration, and discovery across various disciplines.

learning.title: OpenAI Shares How Two Settings Tripled ARC-AGI-3 Scores for GPT-5.6
learning.summary: OpenAI detailed how enabling specific API settings for GPT-5.6 led to a threefold increase in scores on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark, providing valuable insights for developers to enhance model performance and efficiency through reasoning and compaction.

learning.title: LingBot-Map Tutorial: GPU-Aware Inference and Point Cloud Export for 3D Reconstruction
learning.summary: This tutorial provides a comprehensive guide to implementing a streaming 3D reconstruction pipeline using LingBot-Map, covering GPU-aware configuration, GCTStream model inference, and exporting consistent 3D scenes as PLY and NPZ artifacts.
